description: Configure search terms, locations, direct URLs, and extraction options for scraping Yelp business data, reviews, hours, menu, services, photos, and owner replies.

directUrls.description: List of direct Yelp business page URLs to scrape. Use this to scrape specific businesses without searching.
directUrls.title: Direct URLs

fetchHours.description: Extract hours of operation for each day of the week.
fetchHours.title: Extract Hours of Operation

fetchMenu.description: Attempt to extract menu items for restaurants. Adds one extra request per business. Yelp's menu feature is US-only and not available for every restaurant.
fetchMenu.title: Extract Menu (Restaurants)

fetchPhotos.description: Extract all gallery photos grouped by category (food, inside, outside, menu) when available.
fetchPhotos.title: Extract Photo Galleries

locations.description: List of locations to search in (e.g., 'New York, NY', 'Los Angeles, CA'). Each search term is combined with each location.
locations.title: Locations

proxy.description: REQUIRED. Yelp uses Cloudflare protection. Residential proxy is mandatory; datacenter IPs are reliably blocked.
proxy.title: Proxy Configuration

reviewLimit.description: Maximum number of reviews to collect per business. Set to 0 to skip review extraction. Yelp publicly exposes approximately 30 reviews per business.
reviewLimit.title: Reviews per Business

searchLimit.description: Maximum number of business results to collect per search query. Lower values mean faster runs.
searchLimit.title: Search Results Limit

searchTerms.description: List of search queries (e.g., 'pizza', 'plumber', 'hair salon'). Used together with Locations to find businesses on Yelp.
searchTerms.title: Search Terms

title: Yelp Scraper Pro Input
